description: School contact data per child and the school's published information pages. Pass paginaId for one page with its topics and documents; the built-in pages -1 (holidays) and -2 (school contact data) work too. Holidays use the child-specific vakanties endpoint (pass leerlingId when more than one child is linked). Use teachers for staff and children for mentors.

leerlingId.description: Numeric leerling id. Required when more than one child is linked.

paginaId.description: Information page id from the page list of a previous school_info call (-1 = holidays, -2 = school contact data).

name: school_info
title: School information
